attempts.summary: Restored tickets.sql into PostgreSQL 9.5 database helpdesk and repaired tickets_id_seq. Imported tickets remain unchanged at IDs 1, 2, and 100. Default-ID tests allocated 101, 102, and—after reboot—103. Test rows were removed, leaving the original three tickets and the sequence correctly anchored at 100. Node1 rebooted successfully and PostgreSQL, data, sequence, and source export recovered intact.
